anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Uniformly convex curvature characteristic of a low-poly spherical segment at the anterior cranial pole.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered projection with a pixel length roughly equal to its basal thickness, terminating in an acute distal point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable as a wide obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon's descent meets the dorsal plane of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: The subject displays a monochromatic cyan luminescence and a faceted low-poly geometry characteristic of a 3D digital model.
